description: Returns the Flux ID (app owner address), the payment address and its spendable FLUX balance with its USD value. Explains what to configure if keys are missing. Never returns private keys.

fluxIdPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux ID that owns the app. Use a dedicated key from flux_generate_keys, never a main wallet key.

paymentPrivateKey.description: WIF private key of the Flux address that pays. Fund it with only what you intend to spend.

name: flux_get_identity
title: Show the configured Flux identity and balance
